identity.name: NextGen Learning
identity.persona: The Digital Campus - A futuristic yet grounded educational hub.
identity.archetype: Growth & Trust (Archetype 1) fused with Electric Future (Archetype 7)

rules: Headings must use Outfit. Do not use Inter for headings.
Body text must have a line-height of at least 1.6 for readability.
Use 'tracking-tight' for all headings larger than 24px.

primary.description: Royal Blue - Primary Actions, Buttons, Links

secondary.description: Deep Violet - Brand Identity, AI Features, Premium Content

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, or p-12 for containers. Avoid cramped lists.

dashboard_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-full bg-white border-r border-slate-200 hidden md:block z-30
dashboard_layout.header: sticky top-0 z-20 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 h-16 flex items-center px-6

buttons.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50

cards.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

visual_enhancers.glow_effect: absolute -inset-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-violet-600 rounded-lg blur opacity-25 group-hover:opacity-100 transition duration-1000 group-hover:duration-200

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px for a clean, academic look. Use 2px for active states.

images.instructions: Since the image tool failed during discovery, you MUST try to fetch images again using the `image_selector_tool` when building. If it fails, use high-quality gradients matching the stream colors.

categories.hero_bg: Indian students studying online, modern home environment
categories.science_stream: Abstract science, DNA, atoms, blue tones

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background ratio is at least 4.5:1. Use Slate-600 or darker for body text on white.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Wrap complex animations in motion-safe checks.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Avoid generic 'text-center' layouts. Use asymmetric grids.
Dark Mode is critical for the 'Video Player' page to reduce eye strain, even if the rest of the app is Light Mode.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.
Don't use gradients for text. It impairs readability.
